boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on corridors in Molloy University's practical Rockville Centre orbit, each with a directly sourced reason to stop.

cards.title: Rockville Centre Public Library
cards.subtitle: North Village Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the North Village Avenue corridor for a library stop; check the public calendar or browse its digital-library and borrowing options.
cards.short_summary: A public-library destination with evening weekday hours listed online.
cards.evidence_claim: The Rockville Centre Public Library is at 221 North Village Avenue and lists programs, digital resources, and Monday–Thursday evening hours.
cards.access_notes: The library lists hours through 9 p.m. Monday–Thursday; check its site for changes and program registration.

cards.title: Rockville Centre Station
cards.subtitle: North Village Avenue / Front Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the North Village Avenue and Front Street corridor as the rail connection point when planning an off-campus trip or a return to campus.
cards.short_summary: The named rail destination identified by Molloy's transportation guidance.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy directs rail travelers to use the Long Island Rail Road's Rockville Centre Station and states bus and taxi service connect the station and campus.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current LIRR service and campus-shuttle availability before traveling.

cards.entity_name: Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. Community Center
cards.title: Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. Community Center
cards.subtitle: North Centre Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Check the center's program and special-event listings before heading along North Centre Avenue; it is a named Village community facility.
cards.short_summary: A Village-operated community center with programs and special events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Village identifies the Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. Community Center at 150 North Centre Avenue and links to programs and special events.
cards.source_title: Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. Community Center
cards.access_notes: Review the Village's current program details and eligibility before visiting.

cards.title: Rockville Centre Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: North Oceanside Road corridor
cards.notes: Use North Oceanside Road for the Village recreation destination, then consult the registration site for facilities, memberships, or program details.
cards.short_summary: A named Village recreation destination with a dedicated registration portal.
cards.evidence_claim: The Village lists its Recreation Department at 111 North Oceanside Road and directs users to its recreation registration site for programs, memberships, and facilities.
cards.access_notes: Programs and facilities may require registration or membership; verify current requirements online.

cards.title: Eugene J. Murray Village Hall
cards.subtitle: College Place corridor
cards.notes: Walk the College Place corridor to the Village Hall if you want to locate a civic landmark and check official meeting or public-service information.
cards.short_summary: A named civic destination at the center of Village services.
cards.evidence_claim: The Village identifies Village Hall at 1 College Place and lists the Mayor's Office there.
cards.source_title: Village of Rockville Centre Mayor's Office
cards.access_notes: The Mayor's Office lists weekday business hours; public meetings and services have separate schedules.

cards.title: Hue Studio Fine Art Academy
cards.subtitle: Sunrise Highway corridor
cards.notes: Follow the Sunrise Highway corridor to this fine-art academy, then use its directions page to confirm class hours or private-party availability.
cards.short_summary: A named fine-art academy on Sunrise Highway.
cards.evidence_claim: Hue Studio Fine Art Academy lists its address as 326 Sunrise Highway, Rockville Centre, with business hours on its directions page.
cards.source_title: Hue Studio Fine Art Academy Directions
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by day and season; confirm before visiting.

cards.title: Nick's Pizza Rockville Centre
cards.subtitle: Sunrise Highway corridor
cards.notes: Use the Sunrise Highway corridor for this pizza stop; check the restaurant's current carryout and dining hours before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A pizza and Italian-food destination on Sunrise Highway.
cards.evidence_claim: Nick's Pizza lists its Rockville Centre location at 272 Sunrise Highway and identifies pizza, Italian dishes, vegetarian options, and posted business hours.
cards.access_notes: The restaurant posts separate day-based hours; verify service availability before going.

cards.title: Color of Spices
cards.subtitle: Sunrise Highway corridor
cards.notes: Plan a Sunrise Highway meal stop at this Rockville Centre restaurant and consult its official site for the listed address and current business hours.
cards.short_summary: A South Asian restaurant located on Sunrise Highway.
cards.evidence_claim: Color of Spices lists its address as 306 Sunrise Highway, Rockville Centre, and posts business hours on its official website.
cards.access_notes: The official site lists daily hours; check before visiting.

cards.title: 3 Brothers Pizza RVC
cards.subtitle: Merrick Road corridor
cards.notes: Head to the Merrick Road corridor for this pizza café; its official page identifies both traditional and vegan pizza offerings and hours.
cards.short_summary: A Merrick Road pizza café offering traditional and vegan options.
cards.evidence_claim: 3 Brothers Pizza RVC lists 285 Merrick Road, Rockville Centre, and describes itself as serving vegan and traditional pizza.
cards.access_notes: The restaurant posts day-specific hours; confirm before traveling.

cards.title: Salsa Mexicana
cards.subtitle: North Village Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the North Village Avenue corridor for this Mexican restaurant; consult the restaurant's official site for its menu, reservations, and service hours.
cards.short_summary: A Mexican-food destination on North Village Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Salsa Mexicana lists its location at 13 North Village Avenue, Rockville Centre, and posts dining, takeout, delivery, and reservation information.
cards.access_notes: Check current dining, takeout, delivery, and reservation details on the official site.
